# Imen Bouzouita — Digital Product, UX & CRO Consultant, Berlin

> I help e-commerce, wellness, and SaaS brands turn browsers into buyers with research-backed UX audits and interfaces people actually want to use.

Digital Product · UX · CRO Consultant — Berlin. I'm a UX, CRO, and digital strategy consultant based in Berlin. I work with e-commerce, wellness, and SaaS brands that know their product is strong but suspect their website is leaving money on the table. My job is to find out where and fix it — through conversion audits, UX redesigns, landing page builds, and structured A/B testing.

## What I Do

- [UX/CRO and SEO Audits](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/#work-do): 15–30 prioritized fixes. I tell you exactly what's costing you conversions — and how to fix it.
- [Landing Page Redesign](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/#work-do): From wireframe to live page in a week. Built to convert, not just to look nice.
- [Full Website & Shop Builds](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/#work-do): Webflow, Shopify, Framer, WordPress. Structure, UX design, and build — end to end.
- [Neuroscience-Backed Insights](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/#work-do): Worked at the Deloitte Neuroscience Institute. I design with how people actually think, not just how they say they behave.

## Case Studies

- [Sacred Metrics](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/work/sacred-metrics/): Closing the conversion gap for a 20-year wellness brand — A 20-year-old wellness brand in Ubud, Bali with strong organic traffic, genuine guest loyalty, and a domain rating of 62 backed by 13.5K backlinks. The brief: modernise the digital experience, close the gap between offline reputation and online conversion, and assess AI search readiness.
- [The Collective](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/work/the-collective/): From Directory to Community Platform — A ten-year-old wellness directory in Bali with 885 referring domains, Wikipedia citations on its cultural content, and presence in over a hundred Google AI Overviews, embedded in a three-brand ecosystem alongside a physical yoga studio and an annual wellness festival under the same leadership. The site had significant domain authority and editorial content, but no defined strategic role within the ecosystem. The brief: assess the current state, define a strategic direction, and deliver a conversion-focused roadmap connecting the platform to the wider ecosystem.
- [Prima Materia](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/work/prima-materia/): The Practitioner's Site — Applying conversion thinking to my own coaching practice.
- [NeuroBoost UX](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/work/neuroboost-ux/): Uncovering what drives user decisions when surveys and click data can't — Two unrelated projects, the same blind spot: teams making product and marketing decisions based on what users said they wanted, while the numbers kept disagreeing. A digital product team's adoption metrics didn't match glowing survey feedback. A brand couldn't settle on a newsletter layout from stakeholder opinion alone. The brief in both cases: measure what users can't self-report.
- [Conversion Engine](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/work/conversion-engine/): Optimising checkout, product pages, and launch strategy from inside the team — A direct-to-consumer brand with healthy traffic but underperforming conversion. As shop manager and developer, I owned the full e-commerce operation — from product launches and shop optimisation to A/B testing and checkout improvements.
- [Resonance Tunes](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/work/resonance-tunes/): Conscious Tech, Grounded Design — Designing and building the business website for an ethical-AI wellness platform from scratch.

## Resources

- [CRO Audit Checklist: 20 Things to Check Before You Redesign Anything](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/resources/cro-audit-checklist/): A practical, 20-point checklist covering analytics, homepage clarity, checkout friction, and mobile UX — everything worth auditing before committing to a redesign.
- [What Neuromarketing Actually Is (And Isn't)](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/resources/what-neuromarketing-actually-is/): What neuromarketing actually measures, and the assumptions people most often get wrong about it, from someone who's used eye tracking, implicit testing, and biometric methods professionally.

## About

- [About](https://www.imenbouzouita.com/#about): I've spent 10+ years moving between corporate innovation and independent work. At Deloitte, Siemens, and BMW I learned how large organisations approach product, research, and scale. On my own, I learned how to ship fast, prioritise ruthlessly, and make every recommendation something a small team can actually implement. I bring both.
